report.title: Persistent Datapatch bug
report.body:
### Platforms

Android

### Build

BE 27790

### Issue

When you save a datapatch in a map, suddenly, attempting to remove it does not work.
When you remove it, it gets temporarily removed, but gets added back when you open the map.
I tested this with or without mods and it still happened by the way.

### Steps to reproduce

Make map
Add data-patch
Save map
Delete data-patch
Save map
Leave editor
Come back to map editor
See that the data-patch is back.

### Mods used

I tested it in vanilla but here are the mods I usually use.

Auto Research (gone from in-game mod browser?)
Patch Editor (I think this mod doesn't cause the issue)
Patch Viewer
CLaJ

### Save file

I zipped the msav here

[persistent datapatch bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32028828/persistent.datapatch.bug.zip)

### (Crash) logs

_No response_

summary: Observed in 3/5 fresh replays. A stable trigger still needs investigation.

spec.summary: Reported persistence issue in Mindustry map editor: a saved datapatch appears to return after deletion, saving, leaving the editor, and reopening the map.
spec.observed_behavior: The reporter states that after adding and saving a datapatch in a map, deleting the datapatch appears to remove it temporarily. After saving, leaving the editor, and reopening the map, the datapatch is present again. The reporter says the behavior was also observed without mods.
spec.expected_behavior: After a datapatch is deleted and the map is saved, reopening that map in the editor should not restore the deleted datapatch.
known_preconditions: The issue is reported to occur in the map editor.
A datapatch has been added to the map and the map has been saved at least once before attempting deletion.
Reporter claims testing occurred both with usual mods and in vanilla/no-mod conditions.
A save-file archive is linked in the report: persistent.datapatch.bug.zip.
uncertain_conditions: Whether BE 27790 corresponds exactly to the supplied target commit.
Whether the linked archive is available, intact, and contains the affected .msav file and any required accompanying files.
Whether the datapatch is created through the base editor, a mod-provided editor tool, or another workflow.
Whether 'delete/remove' refers to deleting a datapatch object, clearing its contents, removing a tag/marker, or another editor action.
Whether the deletion is visibly reflected before the post-deletion save completes.
Whether the correct map/save slot is reopened after leaving the editor.
Whether autosave, editor save, map import/export, cloud sync, or file restoration is involved.
Whether the issue reproduces in a newly created map versus only an existing or imported map.
Whether it reproduces after a full application restart, rather than only exiting and re-entering the editor.
Whether the vanilla test used a clean profile/session with all mods disabled, including mods previously enabled for the affected map.
Whether any listed mod had previously modified the affected map or its serialized data.
Whether Android storage permissions, save-path behavior, or device-specific conditions affect the result.
Whether Linux evaluation is applicable to the Android-reported reproduction and the same build/content format.
reproduction_hints: On the reported Android build, create a new map in the editor.
Add a datapatch and save the map.
Delete the datapatch, then save the map again.
Exit the editor and reopen the same map.
Check whether the deleted datapatch is restored.
Repeat with a new map and with all mods disabled, while documenting the exact datapatch creation and deletion controls used.
If available, compare the map file before deletion, after deletion/save, and after reopening to determine whether the datapatch data remained in the saved file or was restored later.
required_artifacts: The linked persistent.datapatch.bug.zip archive, including the affected .msav file.
Exact game version/build identifier and confirmation of its relationship to commit 63b2069e9685063c74abc41fae84a66f73e9e09b.
Device model, Android version, and installation/source channel.
A screen recording or screenshots showing: datapatch present, deletion action, post-deletion save, exit/reopen, and restored datapatch.
Exact editor workflow: map type, datapatch type, controls/menu actions used to add, delete, save, exit, and reopen.
Map-file copies captured before deletion, after deletion and save, and after reopening, if accessible.
Logs from the reproduction session, including any editor/save/load warnings or errors.
Confirmation of the vanilla test procedure, including whether all mods were disabled and whether a clean/new map was used.
Versions and sources of the listed mods, if reproduction is also tested with mods enabled.

hypotheses.statement: A datapatch deleted from an editor map is serialized as removed when saving, so it will remain absent after reopening.
hypotheses.prediction: Create map, place datapatch, save; delete and save; reopen shows no datapatch.
hypotheses.observation: The UI showed the datapatch list empty immediately after confirmed deletion. After the post-deletion save, editor exit, and reopening the same named map, the datapatch list again showed '<unnamed> [1 fields]'.
